name: Chang Chi (I)
dates: graduated between AD 742 and 755; lived to AD 780
bio: Chang Chi (I) graduated at the government examinations between AD 742 and 755 and lived to 780.
The poems here are Witter Bynner’s versions, from the texts of Kiang Kang-hu, in The Jade Mountain (1929).

poems.title: A Night-Mooring near Maple Bridge
poems.author: Chang Chi (I)
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
